prompt: Hierarchical edge bundling explorer. Layout switcher: circle pack (d3.pack), treemap (d3.treemap), dendrogram, radial tree, sunburst, icicle. Bundle links with curveBundle and tension slider defaulting to 0.85. Toggle link visibility and link layer order. Click to select nodes, hover to highlight groups. Randomize dataset button using keyed .join() to cross-fade — enter new nodes at full target size (never start small), transition existing nodes to new positions. Use keyed .join(enter, update, exit) for all layout transitions so nodes interpolate smoothly. Circle-pack: draw translucent parent circles as grouping containers. Labels: 11px minimum, anchor text-anchor based on node angle/position (not always right-offset), hide or rotate on collision in radial layouts. Control bar: bold section labels, lighter control text.
